simple.meaning: נָהַג (nâhag) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead , carry away ; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 31 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, and 10 more, beginning at Genesis 31:18. Its contexts include family, family line, flock, Torah, priesthood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָהַג (H5090).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נָהַג (nâhag) / H5090 is traced through Genesis 31:18, Genesis 31:26, Exodus 3:1, Exodus 10:13 as a generated source-based concept entry.

They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

definitions.short: to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead , carry away ; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh
definitions.usage: acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).
definitions.full: H5090. nahag I. נָהַג verb drive, conduct (Late Hebrew conduct oneself, behave, be accustomed ; Arabic go along the road, keep to the road; Aramaic נְהַג lead); — Qal Perfect ׳נ Lam 3:2 ; נָָֽהֲגוּ 1Sam 30:20 ; Imperfect יִנְהַג Isa 20:4 , etc.; Imperative נְהַג 2Kin 4:24 ; Participle active נֹהֵג Isa 11:6 2 t., etc.; passive נְהוּגִים 60:11 ; — 1 drive , flocks Exod 3:1 ; compare (in predict.) Isa 11:6 (followed by בְּ ); figurative, object Joseph, Psa 80:2 (simile of flock); hence, object human being, lead on, Song 8:2 (|| אֶלֿ הֵבִיא )); also figurative, subject ׳י , Lam 3:2 (|| הוֺלִיךְ ); passive participle of kings led in procession Isa 60:11 compare Di (rather than as captives, Che, as earlier usage; || הֵבִיא ); drive away, off , (object מִקְנֶה ) Gen 31:18 ( of Jacob, going by stealth); usually as booty (object flocks and herds) 1Sam 23:5 , ינהגו יתומים חמור Job 24:3 (unjustly); compare 1Sam 30:2 (twice in verse) (read וַיִּנְהֲגוּ We Dr Kit Bu, compare Th, not HPS q. v. ), 30:22 (no object expressed but really captives || הָלַךְ ), Isa 20:4 ; drive an ass for riding 2Kin 4:24 (|| הָלַךְ ); a cart ( עֲגָלָה ) 2Sam 6:3 = 1Chr 13:7 (where ׳בָּע ); absolute of driving chariot 2Kin 9:20 ; lead out an army to battle (late) 1 Chronicles 20:12; 1Chr 25:11 . 2 figurative בַּחָכְמָה נֹהֵג וְלִבִּי Eccl 2:3 my heart behaving itself in wisdom (compare Late Hebrew above). Pi`el Perfect נִהַג Exod 10:3 ; נִהַ֫גְתָּ Isa 63:14 ; Imperfect יְנַהֵג Deut 4:27 , etc.; — 1 drive away, lead off , followed by accusative, daughters of Laban Gen 31:26 (|| גָּנַב ); of ׳י , leading off people into exile, followed by שָׁ֫מָּה Deut 4:27 (|| הֵפִיץ ), 28:37 (|| הוֺלִיךְ ). 2 lead on, guide , followed by accusative, subject ׳י Psa 78:52 ( כַּעֵ֫דֶר || כַּצּאֹן הִסִּיעַ ); Isa 49:10 (|| נִהֵל , compare Psa 23:2 ); Isa 63:14 ; 48:15 ; guide on, a wind, Exod 10:13 (followed by בָּאָרֶץ ), Psa 78:26 ; (|| הִסִּיעַ ). 3 cause to drive (compare Qal , 2Kin 9:20 ) Exod 14:25 (J E; subject ׳י , see Di) II. [ נָהַג ] verb Pi`el moan, lament (Arabic be out of breath, pant, breathe heavily ; Aramaic sigh, groan ); — Pi`el Participle feminine plural מְנַהֲגוֺה Nahum 2:8 ( יוֺנִים כְּקוֺל ).
